name: elysium-testnet-v2-factory
_why: Testnet redeploy with the testnet main wallet, run the same way as mainnet: every value explicit, nothing copied from Cloak v1. Nov 12 first, then again after the Nov 13 GLOAK audit fixes (the auction and the token deployer changed). Writes deployments/elysium-testnet-v2-factory.json over the old record.
_poolManager: Cloak's testnet deployment of Uniswap's exact v4 PoolManager build.
_owner: The testnet main wallet (owner, treasury and deployer roles on testnet only). It calls acceptOwnership() on the config after the deploy.
_vaultVerifier: The verifier of the testnet Gloam vault (Cloak's stand-in since Nov 13, deployments/elysium-testnet-gloam-standin.json). Unused by v2.
